name: astro-r2-comments
description: Astro comments that use Cloudflare R2 for storage.
author: Josh Finnie <josh@jfin.us>

scripts.bump:patch: npm --workspaces --git-tag-version false version patch && npm --git-tag-version false version patch
scripts.bump:minor: npm --workspaces --git-tag-version false version minor && npm --git-tag-version false version minor
scripts.bump:major: npm --workspaces --git-tag-version false version major && npm --git-tag-version false version major
